system.boundary: Build a single-phase-input to three-phase-output power converter using Simscape Specialized Power Systems.
physical_paths: A single-phase AC source must feed a rectifier, a smoothing DC link, and then a controllable three-phase inverter supplying a balanced load.
functional_paths: A single-phase AC source must feed a rectifier, a smoothing DC link, and then a controllable three-phase inverter supplying a balanced load.
The inverter's three output phase voltages must be regulated in closed loop to produce balanced 50 Hz phase voltages with an RMS value of 222 V.
information_paths: Vsrc_amp, P_load -> D014 plant/control path -> Vdc, Vabc, Iabc
modes_and_events: D014 startup and continuous operation follow the current public task contract.
